passages.title: Normalized weighted mean and exponential Jensen
inference_obligations: Encode the normalized tilted expectation by actual weighted integrals divided by the strictly positive mass.
Apply weighted exponential Jensen and domination w≤β(u·g) with all integrability proved.

archive_correspondence.use: Provenance and candidate decomposition only; the present frozen source span and fresh proof dependencies are checked separately.

route_details: Tilt is expressed through normalized weighted integrals rather than an extra withDensity probability-measure object.
The final assembly chooses the tangent direction before the general weighted Jensen/factorization lemmas are instantiated; these lemmas retain their general direction parameters.
The final new proof has the printed independence factorization as an actual proof dependency and does not call the previous final Gaussian entropy theorem.

expanded_types.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    ∀ (β : ℝ → ℝ),
      Measurable β →
        (∀ (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ β a ∧ β a ≤ 1) →
          ∀ (w : RectangleCLT.Vector r → ℝ),
            Measurable w →
              (∀ (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r), 0 ≤ w z ∧ w z ≤ β (RectangleCLT.faceDot u z)) →
                0 < ∫ (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r), β (RectangleCLT.faceDot u z) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r →
                  0 < RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w →
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w *
                        RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq
                          (RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMean (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) id w) ≤
                      ∫ (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                          w z * RectangleCLT.faceDot u z ^ 2 ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r +
                        2 * RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w *
                          Real.log
                            ((∫ (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                                β (RectangleCLT.faceDot u z) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) /
                              RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) w)
